reflection_prompt: What anxiety can you hand over in prayer instead of carrying it yourself?
Where today did you lean on your own understanding instead of trusting God?
Where do you need to be led beside quiet waters right now?
What tomorrow-worry are you carrying today that isn't yours to carry yet?
Which fruit of the Spirit did you see grow in you today?
Was there a moment today you wish you had listened more and spoken less?
Where did the world's pattern pull at you today, and how did you resist it?
What mercy are you grateful to receive fresh today?
What are you still holding onto that you could cast on him?
Where do you need courage tomorrow, and what makes you afraid of it?
What did you do today as if for God rather than for people?
When were you able to be still today, and when did you resist it?
Who is someone you need to extend kindness or forgiveness to right now?
What could you give thanks for today, even in a hard circumstance?
What are you facing that you need God's strength for, not just your own?
Where did you act justly, love mercy, or walk humbly today — or fall short of it?
What would God point out if you asked him to search your heart right now?
What peace has God given you that the world couldn't give you?
What old thing is God making new in you lately?
Where did your plans today meet God's redirecting?
What weight or sin do you need to lay aside to run your race well?
Where has your heart been broken lately, and have you let God near it?
What burden are you carrying that you haven't brought to him for rest?
What hard thing today might God be working for good, even if you can't see it yet?
Where are you tempted to grow weary in doing good?
How did you number today wisely — or waste it?
Where did love look patient and kind today, or where did it fall short?
What has your mind been dwelling on today — is it true, noble, and lovely?
What in your heart needs to be made clean or renewed right now?
Where do you need to be strong and courageous because he goes with you?
Did a gentle answer or a harsh word come out of you today?
Where did you find joy in his presence today?
Where are you trying to earn what's already been given as a gift?
Where do you need his joy to be your strength today?
What decision are you facing that you need his guidance on?
What trial are you in, and what is it teaching you about perseverance?
Is there something you're holding back from confessing and releasing?
What delight have you found in him lately, apart from what you want from him?
Who sharpened you today, or who could you sharpen?
Where did fear try to take the place of the power, love, and self-discipline he's given you?
